In such beliefs, "Akuma" or other similar names might be used to refer to entities believed to bring harm or misfortune, and these beliefs may influence certain aspects of daily life and social interactions.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the term "Akuma" does not hold a positive connotation. In the Islamic worldview, everything comes from Allah (god), and there is no power or influence outside of His will. Belief in entities that bring harm or malice undermines the inherent goodness and purpose of Allah's creation.
